primary_question: Three fresh RTX5060Ti Job/session observations with unchanged Candy GPU artifact and contiguous-HWC probe; compare descriptively against previously measured RTX5080 and Mobilint.
model_preparation: input/output metadata 224x344; immutable initializer inputs removed; IR3 to IR4; ORT1.23.2 basic constant-folding; all original initializers byte-identical
replication_unit: fresh native Job/session; 30 calls nested within each Job
quality: finite matching output, within-runtime repeatability; cross-model numerical differences descriptive, not equivalence proof
amendment: No change to executed probe, model, FP32/TF32, warmup/sample counts, resource requests/limits or image digest. Only GPU device route and identity assertion change.
temporal_design: Additional single-device cohort; three sequential fresh Jobs. Previous RTX5080/Mobilint observations are not concurrent randomized controls.
